cases.prompt: Design a runner that coordinates three LLM agents with handoffs, shared state, retries, and approval gates.

success.name: multi-agent route
success.rubric: Pass if rb-multi-agent-systems is selected and the runner owns transitions, permissions, budgets, and recovery.

cases.prompt: Add one MCP tool to my existing single-agent assistant.

success.name: single-agent MCP exclusion
success.rubric: Pass only if rb-multi-agent-systems is not selected merely because a single agent uses MCP.

cases.prompt: Improve retrieval and structured citations for one LLM agent; there is no delegation or orchestration layer.

success.name: single-agent retrieval exclusion
success.rubric: Pass only if rb-multi-agent-systems is not selected merely because one agent uses retrieval and structured output.
